title: Distinct coordinates for earlier gates
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit with $n$ input bits, let $i$ be a gate index in $C$, and let $j$ be an index strictly earlier than $i$. Then the coordinate assigned to $i$ differs from the coordinate assigned to the gate at index $j$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean circuit with n input bits
A gate index i in the circuit
An index j strictly earlier than i
